linux: t=$(mktemp); if emacs --batch -l org --eval '(org-babel-tangle-file "init.org")' >"$t" 2>&1; then git diff --quiet -- init.el early-init.el || { echo 'NOTE: committed init.el/early-init.el out of sync with init.org:'; git diff --name-only -- init.el early-init.el; }; git checkout -- init.el early-init.el; rm -f "$t"; else echo 'Tangle failed:'; cat "$t"; rm -f "$t"; exit 1; fi
